# Wine Radar

> Every winery in Europe's wine regions on a map: producer pages with location, website, guide ratings and press, plus places to eat and stay, trip planning and books. Independent and free to use. Data from Falstaff and other wine guides, the wineries' own websites, OpenStreetMap and Wikimedia Commons; checked weekly.

Languages: English (main), German, Dutch, Swedish and 19 more. Methods: https://wineradar.net/how-we-work/
